examples.arabic: نَحْنُ نُسَاعِدُ بَعْضَنَا لِأَنَّنَا جُزْءٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْمُجْتَمَعِ.
examples.english: We help each other because we are part of this community.
examples.transliteration: Nahnu nusaaidu badanaa liannanaa juzun min haadha al-mujtamai.
examples.storyTitle: The Good Friends in the Neighborhood

examples.arabic: كانت جدتها تبتسم بحنان وتجيب بصبر عن كل سؤال حتى عن معنى الاحترام والتعاون في المجتمع
examples.english: Her grandmother would smile tenderly and patiently answer every question, even about the meaning of respect and cooperation in society
examples.transliteration: Kaanat jaddatuhaa tabtasimu bi-hananin wa tujeebu bi-sabrin 'an kulli su'aalin hatta 'an ma'na al-ihtiraam wa at-ta'aawun fi al-mujtama'

examples.arabic: لاحظت كيف يظهر الاحترام للكبار في كل تفاعل وهو من اجمل تقاليد المجتمع
examples.english: I noticed how respect for elders was shown in every interaction, which is one of society's most beautiful traditions.
examples.transliteration: Lahaztu kayfa yuzhirul-ihtiram lil-kibar fi kulli tafaa'ul wa huwa min ajmal taqaleed al-mujtama'.

examples.arabic: هذه الأحداث تقوي روابط المجتمع وتذكرنا بأهمية التكافل الاجتماعي
examples.english: These events strengthen community bonds and remind us of the importance of social solidarity
examples.transliteration: Hadhihi al-aḥdāth tuqawwī rawābiṭ al-mujtamaʿ wa-tudhakkirunā bi-ahammiyyat at-takāful al-ijtimāʿī

examples.arabic: ادرك الجميع ان هذه التجمعات هي الاساس لتقوية روابط الاسرة والحفاظ على قيم المجتمع
examples.english: Everyone realized that these gatherings are the foundation for strengthening family bonds and preserving society's values.
examples.transliteration: Adraka al-jamīʿ an hadhihi at-tajammuʿāt hiya al-asās li-taqwiyat rawābiṭ al-usrah wa-al-ḥifāẓ ʿalā qiyam al-mujtamaʿ
examples.storyTitle: A Generational Gathering at the Dining Table

examples.arabic: تحدثنا عن اخبارنا اليومية وعن احوال العائلة والمجتمع
examples.english: We talked about our daily news and the conditions of the extended family and society.
examples.transliteration: Taḥaddathnā ʿan akhbārinā al-yawmiyyah wa ʿan aḥwāl al-ʿā'ilah wal-mujtamaʿ.
